mentions.name: Stagecraft
mentions.description: Stagecraft is a CI framework built on top of Hera (the Argo Workflows Python SDK) that provides CI "primitives" to make it easier for teams to build CI pipelines on Argo Workflows.
mentions.problem: The author's team is limited to Argo Workflows for CI and wanted to stop building and maintaining their own custom CI product on top of it.
mentions.audience: Teams and developers who need to build CI pipelines on Argo Workflows.
mentions.source_excerpt:
So, I’ve been working on this CI “framework” on top of Hera (the Argo Workflows Python SDK, which is really neat) that will hopefully make it easier for our team to build CI pipelines, with CI “primitives.”

It’s called Stagecraft: https://github.com/elliottmoos/stagecraft
mentions.author: elliottmoos
